turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, you have reached support. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I cannot log in to my account. It says my password is wrong but I am sure it is correct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with that. Can you confirm the email on the account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is john.doe at example dot com.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I have sent a password reset link to that address. It is valid for one hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got it, the email just arrived. I am in now, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, anything else I can help with?
